# healthcare-clinical-interop

Clinical interoperability for HIS/EMR/EHR/LIS/HIE: HL7 v2 (2.1–2.9.1), FHIR (DSTU2–R6) with per-IG versions, CDA/C-CDA and IHE ITI document sharing and patient identity.

Install: `copilot plugin install healthcare-clinical-interop@healthcare-copilot` (see the repository README).

## Agents
- `hl7v2-integration-engineer`
- `fhir-engineer`
- `cda-ccda-engineer`
- `ihe-profile-advisor`
- `clinical-terminology-specialist`
